title: Multiples of 4, 6 or 9: Don't Count Twice! | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
How many whole numbers from 1 to 1000 are multiples of 4, 6 or 9? Adding the three counts is not enough, because some numbers sneak in twice. Vantee shows you how to fix the overcount with a Venn diagram, a faster "build it up" trick, and a new puzzle for you to try.
